agreements: Gearbox v1 verified baseline and Step009 Heartbeat verified foundation remain preserved; this review changes no formal state and claims no C PASS.
Heartbeat, poll, retry, reconnect, wait, scheduler wake, window age, uptime and self-test loops remain zero Experience.
v2 now uses one strict_bool helper for inherited routing booleans; prior inherited truthiness defects remain resolved in current bytes.
v2.1 handles terminal N/R before anti-thrash numeric parsing and bounds non-Mapping ledger elements.
v2 rejects missing event_id before verifier parsing, so the previous missing-ID malformed-verifier batch DoS is resolved for identity-less records.
v2 real_experience_claim_allowed now additionally requires verification_stage=C_VERIFIED, which is useful fail-closed hardening but still not verifier provenance.
DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND remain operational progress only in v2.1 and must never become verified Experience, P_base, Trust, Identity, Personality or Governance evidence.
verified_progress_density remains reason-only and does not raise selected gear; it is acceptable only as observational metadata until independently derived.
GEARBOX_V2_1_CONTRACT correctly keeps speedup NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED and formal_mutation_allowed remains false.

disagreements.finding: Material new defect: aggregate_experience_events parses independently_verified for every Mapping with a non-empty event_id before deciding whether the event kind is verified, operational or zero-credit. A valid-ID WAIT/HEARTBEAT/DURABLE_PROGRESS record carrying malformed independently_verified such as the string false raises GearboxGuardError and aborts the whole batch, censoring later valid evidence even though verification is irrelevant to that record's credit class.
disagreements.required_change: Classify canonical event kind before verifier parsing. Parse/validate verifier evidence only for verified kinds; operational/zero-credit kinds must either ignore irrelevant verifier metadata or bounded-reject only that record under a versioned schema. In non-atomic ingestion, one malformed irrelevant field must not abort later independent valid evidence and must not reserve identity.

disagreements.finding: Material wrapper inconsistency: select_gear_v2 canonicalizes current_gear with strip().upper(), but select_gear_v2_1 later re-reads the raw v2_kwargs current_gear using upper() without strip before int(current_gear[1:]). An input such as ' G3 ' is accepted by inherited v2 yet can crash the v2.1 anti-thrash wrapper with ValueError. The wrapper is therefore not closed over the inherited v2 accepted-input domain.
disagreements.required_change: Do not re-parse raw current_gear in v2.1. Consume a canonical current-gear value from a trusted runtime-state receipt or, at minimum for candidate code, one shared normalization function used once before v2/v2.1 logic. All inputs accepted by inherited v2 must either remain valid in v2.1 or fail at one bounded typed boundary before partial routing.

disagreements.finding: experience_candidate_delta normalizes event_kind with str(...), but select_gear_v2 later computes verified_event using event_kind.upper() on the original caller value. A non-string event_kind can raise an uncaught AttributeError after part of the path executes.
disagreements.required_change: Create one canonical typed EventKind intake before any routing/credit logic and use only that normalized value throughout v2/v2.1.

disagreements.finding: current_gear and verification_stage remain caller-supplied authority-sensitive inputs. current_gear controls one-step hysteresis and v2.1 anti-thrash; caller-supplied C_VERIFIED controls promotion/real-Experience gating labels.
disagreements.required_change: Derive current_gear from canonical monotonic runtime/shift-state receipt and verification_stage from exact trusted C/independent-verifier acceptance evidence bound to mission/step/scope, runtime/install identity, policy, freshness/revocation and state fingerprint.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh and authority_conflict remain caller declarations. Strict bool proves type only, not source, timestamp/TTL, revocation, policy or runtime/install binding.
disagreements.required_change: Consume trusted SecretarySignalEnvelope and AuthorityDecisionEnvelope with replay-resistant provenance/freshness binding.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict only replaces secretary_level with UNKNOWN; it does not load or enforce the actual fresh authority decision. Permissive caller kwargs can still drive fallback routing.
disagreements.required_change: On authority conflict, project the exact trusted authority snapshot or fail closed; stale/revoked/cross-scope authority evidence must be rejected.

disagreements.finding: Secretary freshness only guards secretary_level. Numeric pressure fields have no per-field provenance/freshness binding, so stale secretary-derived context/tool/stale-pointer telemetry can still cause checkpoint/downshift.
disagreements.required_change: Bind provenance/freshness per pressure component; stale secretary-derived components are ignored while independently trusted fresh runtime telemetry may contribute.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio remains caller supplied and thresholded at >=0.50 without canonical numerator/denominator, minimum support, observation window, uncertainty or stateful enter/exit hysteresis.
disagreements.required_change: Derive shift-rate from canonical append-only shift history with preregistered support/window/uncertainty and bounded hysteretic release.

disagreements.finding: Anti-thrash can reduce gear_shift_rate while delaying a necessary safe upshift and worsening cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure_per_hour or recovery_latency.
disagreements.required_change: Require paired performance non-regression and bounded release/cooldown; fewer shifts alone is not improvement.

disagreements.finding: Verified Experience still depends on verified event kind plus booleans/stage strings; exact evidence hash, trusted verifier identity and acceptance receipt are not mandatory.
disagreements.required_change: Require immutable evidence identity plus trusted C/independent-verifier receipt bound to mission/step/scope, freshness/revocation and installation/workspace identity.

disagreements.finding: event_id dedupe exists only within one aggregate invocation. Same evidence under new IDs, cross-run/restart/rollback/poll replay and same-ID rebinding can be re-credited.
disagreements.required_change: Use a durable rollback-resistant event/evidence-lineage acceptance registry: exact replay=no-op, same-evidence/new-ID=lineage duplicate, same-ID/different-binding=IDENTITY_CONFLICT.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 recomputes verified and operational deltas directly from caller event fields, bypassing aggregate_experience_events and any future durable-ledger repair.
disagreements.required_change: Both credit classes must come from one immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt; receipt-less decision calls emit zero credit.

disagreements.finding: Public v2 still exposes DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND through experience_candidate_delta although v2.1 classifies them operational-only.
disagreements.required_change: Unify v2/v2.1 authoritative classification; operational events must never appear in an authoritative Experience-labelled field.

disagreements.finding: 5/4/3 verified credits and operational 1 remain engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability units.
disagreements.required_change: Never interpret aggregate credit as capability truth, Trust, Identity/Personality evidence or promotion threshold.

disagreements.finding: No executable matched paired-baseline protocol establishes speedup; commit count, wake count or awake time are invalid substitutes.
disagreements.required_change: Use sealed matched workloads and paired/crossover baselines over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with frozen numerator/denominator provenance, exposure/censoring/order, full assigned-workload coverage, uncertainty and verification/risk non-regression.

statistical_risks: Malformed verifier metadata on non-verified events can censor later valid evidence and create order-dependent missingness in longitudinal Experience/progress statistics.
v2/v2.1 current-gear normalization mismatch can selectively crash only wrapper evaluations, biasing candidate-vs-baseline comparisons toward inputs that happen to use canonical formatting.
Caller-forged current_gear or verification_stage contaminates routing and real-Experience eligibility comparisons.
Caller-declared secretary freshness/authority conflict invalidates causal routing comparisons.
Stale secretary-derived numeric pressure may survive secretary-level freshness suppression.
Small-n shift-rate estimates can false-trigger or chatter at a single threshold.
Anti-thrash can improve gear_shift_rate while worsening cycle, verified-closure throughput or recovery latency.
verified_progress_density becomes self-reinforcing if policy-created progress is later fed back into routing authority.
Transient event identity plus direct decision-path credit can inflate longitudinal verified/operational totals.
Operational-vs-Experience semantics differ between public v2 and v2.1 interfaces.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.
Speed metrics are denominator/exposure/order/workload-coverage sensitive and require matched paired/crossover evaluation.
proposed_tests: GB21-IRRELEVANT-VERIFIER-BATCH-091: [WAIT with valid event_id and independently_verified='false', then a valid verified event] must bounded-reject/ignore the first record and still accept the second; no batch exception.

GB21-OPERATIONAL-VERIFIER-BATCH-092: DURABLE_PROGRESS with malformed irrelevant verifier metadata must not abort later valid records or create verified credit; operational acceptance policy must be explicit.

GB21-CURRENT-GEAR-NORMALIZATION-093: current_gear=' G3 ' must either normalize once and behave identically to G3 throughout v2/v2.1 or fail at one typed boundary before inherited routing; no ValueError in wrapper anti-thrash.
GB21-EVENT-KIND-TYPE-089 + EVENT-KIND-CONSISTENCY-090: all event-kind classification uses one canonical typed value and never raw caller .upper().
GB21-CURRENT-GEAR-PROVENANCE-087 + VERIFICATION-STAGE-PROVENANCE-088: forged caller history/stage cannot override canonical bound state/receipt.
GB21-STALE-PRESSURE-PROVENANCE-059 + MIXED-SOURCE-060: stale secretary-derived numeric fields are ignored; trusted independent telemetry remains usable.
GB21-AUTHORITY-DECISION-PROJECTION-028: fresh authority=G1/recovery must project G1 even when fallback caller kwargs are permissive.
GB21-SHIFT-RATE-PROVENANCE-017 + SHIFT-SMALL-N-004 + ANTI-THRASH-CHATTER-040 + RELEASE-041: canonical shift history, adequate support, uncertainty and bounded release are required.
GB21-PROGRESS-DENSITY-FORGE-007: verified_progress_density=1 alone has zero routing/Experience/promotion/authority effect.
GB21-CROSS-RUN-SAME-ID-018 + ROLLBACK-LEDGER-019 + POLL-REPLAY-020 + EVENT-REBIND-021: durable exactly-once and identity-conflict semantics survive restart, rollback and polling.
GB21-VERIFIER-EVIDENCE-011: verified kind/stage without exact evidence hash plus trusted verifier/C receipt gets zero authoritative credit.
GB21-DIRECT-CREDIT-BYPASS-022 + OPERATIONAL-CREDIT-BYPASS-024: every nonzero credit is tied to one immutable accepted receipt.
GB21-V2-V21-CLASSIFIER-CONSISTENCY-078: operational progress can never enter authoritative Experience-labelled fields.
GB21-CREDIT-SCORE-014: equal aggregate scores from different event mixes cannot imply equivalent capability or trigger promotion.

GB21-PAIRED-SPEED-015 + WAKE-DENOMINATOR-FREEZE-030 + TIME-WINDOW-FREEZE-032 + ORDER-CROSSOVER-036 + ITT-WORKLOAD-COVERAGE-038: speedup requires matched workload, frozen metric provenance, crossover/order control, full assigned-workload coverage and uncertainty/non-regression.

candidate_only_until: non-atomic ledger ingestion isolates irrelevant/malformed verifier metadata and cannot censor later independent evidence
v2 and v2.1 share one canonical current-gear normalization/state source without wrapper-only parse failures
freshness and authority are receipt/envelope bound rather than caller declarations
current_gear and verification_stage are canonical-state/verifier-receipt derived
event_kind has one strict canonical type/normalization boundary
verified Experience requires exact evidence identity and trusted verifier receipt
event/evidence acceptance is durable, rollback-resistant and lineage-deduplicated across runs
v2.1 decision credit consumes only immutable accepted receipts and public v2/v2.1 operational-vs-Experience semantics are unified
anti-thrash metric is canonically derived with sufficient support, uncertainty and hysteretic release, with paired performance non-regression
speedup is demonstrated by matched paired/crossover durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency, not commit/wake/awake time
exact-current v1/v2/v2.1 regression evidence receives the required independent Spirit/Navigator/formal review path
